approaches.name: Smart Labs with preloaded digital content and devices in schools
approaches.description: The project equips schools with Smart Labs of digital devices, projectors, local networks and solar charging, preloaded with digital textbooks and science content. Practices: Smart Labs with preloaded digital textbooks and science labs; Smart Labs with teacher and student digital devices in schools.

evidence.text: The project will finance the procurement of IT equipment for a multi-purpose Smart Lab in approximately 388 schools in two phases.

extra_evidence.text: The Smart Lab will include digital devices, projectors, local network equipment, a solar charging system (if the school is not connected to the electrical grid), and other necessary equipment and materials.

The student devices will be preloaded with digital textbooks and digital science labs developed under this sub-component, and teacher devices will be preloaded with teacher guides with structured lessons, teaching-learning resources and teacher professional development content also developed under this sub-component and sub-component 2.2.

approaches.name: ICT monitoring tool and Allô Ecole mobile reporting platform
approaches.description: Inspectors use an annual ICT monitoring tool to track digital package adoption, while teachers and parents report fund misuse through the Allô Ecole mobile platform. Practices: ICT monitoring tool tracking adoption of digital package; Allô Ecole mobile platform for reporting fund misuse.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: inspector-run ICT adoption monitoring for course correction - cue: 'course-correction' | category Operational; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Technical assistance will also be funded to: (i) support the development of an ICT in education policy and strategy to guide technology investments and align them with key education goals and the medium-term expenditure framework, and to develop a policy pertaining to student and teacher data security and privacy; and (ii) develop an annual ICT monitoring tool.

extra_evidence.text: The project will finance the training of inspectors in the five core focus provinces in the use of the tool, as well as logistics support to conduct a monitoring exercise during at least two years to determine the adoption and use of the digital package supported by the project, and to identify challenges and provide course-correction recommendations that will inform the roll-out of phase 2 schools.

Mitigation measures will include rigorous monitoring of fund use with efficient traceability; periodic report submissions and internal controls; an external annual audit of project financial statements; use of the mobile platform Allô Ecole through which teachers, parents and other stakeholders will be able to report misuse of funds, which in turn will be subject to a case management protocol; and frequent World Bank fiduciary implementation support.

category.rationale: Operational: changes how roll-out is monitored and adjusted

sector.rationale: Inspector monitoring tool strengthens education administration and oversight.
